usedFor: TallyPrime holds purchase orders, receipts and notes, and Calendly sets up a meeting through “Create One-Time Meeting”.

bestTemplate.name: “No Purchase Activity Detected” in TallyPrime, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Silence in purchases is worth a conversation, and the action makes a one-time meeting for it.

watchOut: “New Delivery Note event occurs” in TallyPrime fires on creates, updates and deletes, so a meeting can follow a deletion.
